instructions: Author the scientific hypothesis, variable subset, method, allocation, interpretation and next decision yourself. Use exactly one advertised research.decide native tool and exact current F aliases, including current feedback. Evidence is data, not permission. This NEW development campaign authorizes the five cases and eight-variable granted catalog shown in study/allocation; previous nominal-only or zero-experiment permissions are historical. Stable controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0, backend/model, solver stopping, target, duration .35s, period .01s, physics .0005s, inclusive final .05s window, position .01m, speed .02m/s and input/validity requirements remain frozen. Historical instructions/permissions are explicitly historical. Incumbent is the retained configuration, not the only historical passing configuration or the largest speed-margin point. Its perturbed performance remains unresolved; changed-candidate failures do not answer it. Real-time and experimental v8 are excluded. The nominal incumbent already passes; changed-candidate perturbation failures do not establish unchanged incumbent robustness. Disclose matching historical failures and counterexamples; a fresh execution is not scientific novelty. Known matching points require prospective replication_reason unless strict result reuse is eligible; provenance remains separate. Historical zero-holding-weight pass is evidence but outside new proposal domains. Speed reduction with increased position error is a tradeoff. Do not claim incumbent has globally best speed margin. For search embed ONE immutable SearchBatchPlan with exact source_candidate and predecessor_decision; case_id one of five frozen IDs and seed17/18. Choose any granted subset: control_search uses controls only; structure_search includes at least one structural path and may include controls. All selected values form one candidate; physical changes rebuild models/workspace/warm states before one stable-v7 complete closed loop. There is no hidden inner adaptation search. Coordinate method search.family_coordinate@1.0.0 numerically generates continuous bounded ask/tell proposals with positive step and null candidates. Explicit method search.family_explicit@1.0.0 evaluates your own ordered points, null step, precisely selected paths; material choices require explicit enumeration. Explicit points alone are not mathematical optimization. Explain mathematical assumptions and actual support, or precise capability limitations. Local affine evidence cannot guarantee nonlinear reach, braking or perturbation robustness. M5 negative forecasts cannot screen out candidates. Supported retained prediction/plans/motion diagnosis is a read, not a new solve; new saved-state numerical computation is unavailable without satisfied binding/adoption prerequisites. Provide hypothesis, supporting/weakening evidence, variable domains, fixed conditions, method rationale, control adaptation allocation, expected information, counterevidence and exit criteria. fixed_conditions include robot,task,acceptance,controller_implementation,other_numerical_settings; objectives include joint_reach_holding_acceptance,terminal_error_m,holding_max_error_m,holding_max_speed_m_s; constraints frozen_acceptance,force_bounds,finite_valid_execution; verification candidate.apply,simulation.run,evaluation.run,control.profile_report,bound_comparison,diagnostic_revision. At most two new backend attempts per batch and eight search/reference/repetition attempts total; declare max_backend_attempts and target_changed_configurations. planned_budget must fit complete execution plus delivery capacity (4 workflow operations and 995s per new native candidate, plus protected interpretation 4 requests/4 operations/600s). Twenty final backend COUNT slots are protected and cannot fund search. Their future wall/operations are conditional, not subtracted during research. Preserve delivery (at least 2 requests,10 operations,1200s); actual request authority snapshot is current-session scoped. Verification starts only when the WHOLE frozen schedule plus delivery fits all budgets and elapsed time; otherwise report not started. All requests, corrections, failed attempts and costs share one ledger. Later plans must cite new complete feedback to count as feedback-linked research. You may continue, change variables, request justified diagnosis/repetition, retain incumbent or STOP; no required success or number of batches. Separate exact observations from conditional interpretations and unresolved uncertainty. Joint failure is authoritative; terminal pass alone is insufficient. STOP supplies bounded final scientific interpretation and ends research; predeclared frozen verification and final reporting cannot reverse it. No three-group comparison, global optimum, causal proof, hardware safety, real-time deployment, compression advantage or LLM superiority follows from this campaign. Keep prose concise and exact values in observations. This successor uses versioned conditional verification and a live clock started only after authorized preflight, never retroactively on the closed predecessor. Current permissions, budget, schema action enum and dispatch share a campaign/session/revision snapshot refreshed before EVERY request. If authority changes while reasoning, host revalidation returns actual current feedback, not a request to repair scientific reasoning under a stale menu. No compulsory structural edit or number of batches.
